newsitem.title: JAPAN: Asahi Bank says no big losses at NY branch -- Kyodo.
newsitem.headline: Asahi Bank says no big losses at NY branch -- Kyodo.

text.p: Asahi Bank has not incurred any huge losses at its New York branch, bank president Shigehiko Yoshino said in an interview with Kyodo news agency on Thursday.
"There is absolutely no case where we incurred large losses," Yoshino said in response to rumours that Asahi Bank's New York branch had incurred huge losses.
Yoshino also acknowledged that bank employees opened the Federal Reserve's sealed inspection report on Asahi and said he realised the bank might face penalities for that.
Kyodo said earlier that Asahi Bank's New York branch could face legal action for looking at a confidential Fed inspection report.
"The act violates the Fed's internal rules and I suppose we will face some form of penalty," Yoshino said.
Kyodo reported that Japan's Ministry of Finance had been informed of the matter and would cooperate with U.S. authorities to decide any measures to be taken against the bank.
A MOF official said he was not immediately able to comment on the report.
